## What's new

- **Your phone as a remote.** Press **R** while presenting, or click the phone button, and scan the QR code. Your phone shows big Next/Back buttons, the slide title, what comes next, your notes and the timer. You can also swipe. It runs in your own Wi-Fi with no app, no account and no cloud. A random key in the address makes sure only people who see the QR code can control the talk.
- **Icons on nodes.** Choose from 64 icons in the right-click menu. They appear in the branch colour on the mind map, in the tour and on slides. In Markdown they are written as `:rocket:`, like GitHub emojis. The example "The Universe" has an icon on every branch.
- **Update notice.** Once per start, Mindful asks GitHub whether a newer version exists and shows an *Update* button in the status bar. You can switch this off under *Help*.
- **Fix:** The F1 help listed outdated presentation keys.

## Download

`Mindful-macos-arm64.zip`: macOS 11 or newer on Apple silicon (M1 and newer).

Mindful isn't notarized by Apple yet. After the first launch attempt, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Alternatively, run:

```
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Mindful.app
```

If the macOS firewall is on, allow Mindful to accept incoming connections when you first use the phone remote.
